slice: Reuse integer ratio conversion for Decimal128 scales 23 through 31
scope: Optional Arrow Rust patch after arrow-decimal-to-double-exact.patch. For positive scales 23 through 31, reuse the exact integer ratio helper with 5^scale and multiply by the exact power 2^-scale.

Candidate loop starts aligned to 64 bytes are slower in this series; the other measured offsets recover the baseline timing. This demonstrates placement sensitivity in this standalone binary on this host, not a universal compiler or CPU cost model.

Moving the identical Arrow loop in diagnostic binaries recovers baseline speed. No startup padding or alignment workaround is included in the optional Arrow patch; the original measurements are retained.
